name: @activepieces/piece-feathery
description: Build powerful forms, workflows, and document automation.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

create_form.name: create_form
create_form.description: Create a form based on an existing template form.

form_name.description: The name of the new form (must be unique).

template_form_id.description: Select the template form to copy from.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

enabled.description: Whether the created form should be enabled. If not set, inherits from template.

steps.description: Define the steps for your form.

template_step_id.description: ID of the step to copy from the template. Leave empty to auto-create.

origin.description: Set to true if this is the first step of the form.

id.description: ID of the image element to edit.

asset.description: Name of the image asset from the template theme.

id.description: ID of the video element to edit.

asset.description: Name of the video asset from the template theme.

step_id.description: The step containing this text element.

id.description: ID of the text element to edit.

asset.description: Name of the text asset from the template theme.

id.description: ID of the button to edit.

text.description: Text to display on the button.

asset.description: Name of the button asset from the template theme.

step_progress_bars.description: Edit progress bar elements on steps.

step_id.description: The step containing this progress bar.

id.description: ID of the progress bar to edit.

asset.description: Name of the progress bar asset from the template theme.

id.description: ID of the field to copy.

field_id.description: ID to set for the field. Links to existing field data if ID exists.

max_length.description: Maximum length of the field value.

min_length.description: Minimum length of the field value.

submit_trigger.description: Does filling out this field trigger step submission?

asset.description: Name of the field asset from the template theme.

navigation_rules.description: Define how users navigate between steps.

previous_step_id.description: The step the user is coming from.

next_step_id.description: The step the user is going to.

element_type.description: Type of element that triggers navigation.

element_id.description: ID of the element that triggers navigation.

navigation_conditions.description: Conditions for navigation rules. Reference the navigation rule by its index (0-based).

rule_index.description: Index of the navigation rule (0 for first rule, 1 for second, etc.).

field_key.description: ID of the field to compare.

logic_rules.description: Advanced logic rules for the form.

index.description: Order in which this rule executes.

steps_csv.description: Step IDs that trigger the rule (for submit/load events). Separate with commas.

elements_csv.description: Element IDs that trigger the rule (for change/error/view/action events). Separate with commas.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Feathery form by cloning an existing template form and applying step/element overrides (images, videos, texts, buttons, fields, navigation rules, logic rules). Use to provision a new form programmatically from a template; requires a unique form name and the template form ID. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate form.

update_form.name: update_form
update_form.description: Update a form's properties including status and translations.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

enabled.description: Whether the form should be enabled or disabled.

translations.description: Add translations for form text. Note: This will override existing translations.

language_code.description: Language code (e.g., "es" for Spanish, "fr" for French).

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Feathery form identified by its form ID, optionally setting a new name, enabled/disabled status, and text translations. Use to rename, enable/disable, or localize a form. Note that supplied translations overwrite the form's existing translation set. Idempotent: re-running with the same input leaves the form in the same state.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

confirm_delete.description: Check to confirm deletion. This action cannot be undone.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a Feathery form identified by its form ID; this cannot be undone. Use when an agent must remove a form entirely. Requires the confirm-delete flag to be set or the call errors. Not idempotent — the form is removed once and subsequent calls target a non-existent form.

list_form_submissions.name: list_form_submissions
list_form_submissions.description: List submission data for a particular form.

form_id.description: Select the form to get submissions for.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

start_time.description: Limit submissions to after this update time.

end_time.description: Limit submissions to before this update time.

created_after.description: Limit submissions to after this creation time.

created_before.description: Limit submissions to before this creation time.

count.description: Limit the number of returned submissions.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of field IDs to return.

no_field_values.description: Don't return field data. More performant for large datasets.

sort.description: How to sort the returned field values.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (default 500, max 1000).

use_cache.description: Use cached data for faster response (may be a few minutes old).

field_search.description: Search for submissions with specific field values.

fuzzy_search_threshold.description: Score threshold between 0 and 1 for fuzzy search.

fuzzy_search_parameters.description: Fields and terms for fuzzy search. Weights must sum to 1.

weight.description: Importance of this field (0-1). All weights must sum to 1.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves submission records for a given Feathery form, with optional filters for creation/update time windows, completion status, specific field IDs, exact field-value matches, and fuzzy search across weighted fields. Use to read or search existing form submissions; the form ID is required and all filters are optional (omitting them returns all submissions). Read-only and idempotent.

export_submission_pdf.name: export_submission_pdf
export_submission_pdf.description: Create a PDF export for a specific form submission.

form_id.description: Select the form to export submission from.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

user_id.description: Select the user whose submission to export.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

aiMetadata.description: Generates a PDF export of one user's submission for a specific Feathery form, identified by form ID and user ID. Use to produce a downloadable PDF of a completed submission. Not idempotent — each call triggers a new export generation.

new_submission.name: new_submission
new_submission.description: Triggers when a user submits data through your form.

form_id.description: Select the form to monitor for submissions.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new submission is received for the selected Feathery form, including partial/incomplete submissions. Each event represents one submission record with its field values and user ID. Polls the form for submissions updated since the last check.

form_completed.name: form_completed
form_completed.description: Triggers when a form is completed by an end user.

form_id.description: Select the form to monitor for completions.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an end user fully completes the selected Feathery form (only completed submissions, unlike the new-submission trigger which also includes partial ones). Each event represents one completed submission with its field values and user ID.

file_submitted.name: file_submitted
file_submitted.description: Triggers when a file is submitted in your form, or when a document is signed/generated.

lookup_type.description: Choose how to find document envelopes.

document_id.description: The ID of the document template to monitor.

user_id.description: Select the user to monitor for file submissions.

auth.description: Your Feathery admin API key. You can get an API key by creating an account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a document envelope is created — i.e. a file is submitted, signed, or generated in Feathery. Monitors either by a document template ID or by a user (selected via the lookup-by mode), and each event represents one envelope including its file URL, signer/sender, and signed/viewed status.
